what: The deck is the single source of truth
title: Getting started with maumauR
text: Everything package derived one specification. box states 32 cards. Four colours, one +2 one skip per colour, four wild cards leave exactly five number faces per colour - default gets 32. face values 1:5, confirmed physical deck; change every simulation, summary, plot package follows. specification total 32 accepted, warns, wrongly built deck can never pass unnoticed: mm_build_deck() turns specification one row per physical card:
code: spec <- mm_deck_spec() spec #> <mm_deck_spec>: 32 cards in 4 colours #> • colours: "red", "green", "blue", and "yellow" #> • number faces per colour: 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 #> • +2 per colour: 1; skip per colour: 1 #> • wild cards: 4 #> • cards per colour: 7 wrong <- try(mm_deck_spec(numbers = 0:5), silent = TRUE) #> Warning: ! The deck specification totals 36 cards, but the box states 32. #> ℹ Correct the `mm_deck_spec()` arguments after a physical card count; every #>   simulation, summary, and plot follows from them. deck <- mm_build_deck(spec) deck #> # A tibble: 32 × 3 #>    color value type   #>    <chr> <int> <chr>  #>  1 red       1 number #>  2 red       2 number #>  3 red       3 number #>  4 red       4 number #>  5 red       5 number #>  6 green     1 number #>  7 green     2 number #>  8 green     3 number #>  9 green     4 number #> 10 green     5 number #> # ℹ 22 more rows table(deck$type) #>  #> number  plus2   skip   wild  #>     20      4      4      4

title: Getting started with maumauR
text: mm_play_game() deals table, plays artificial opponents, returns single tidy row. trace column audit trail. Switch every step records size every pile, package checks card ever lost duplicated:
code: mm_play_game(n_players = 3, seed = 1) #> # A tibble: 1 × 7 #>   winner turns draws n_players hand_sizes strategy  trace            #>    <int> <int> <int>     <int> <list>     <list>    <list>           #> 1      1    35    16         3 <int [3]>  <chr [3]> <tibble [0 × 7]> traced <- mm_play_game(n_players = 3, seed = 1, trace = TRUE) head(traced$trace[[1]]) #> # A tibble: 6 × 7 #>    turn player action       hand_cards draw_pile discard_pile total #>   <int>  <int> <chr>             <int>     <int>        <int> <int> #> 1     0      1 deal                 15        16            1    32 #> 2     1      1 play_plus2           14        16            2    32 #> 3     2      2 draw_penalty         16        14            2    32 #> 4     3      3 play_plus2           15        14            3    32 #> 5     4      1 draw_penalty         17        12            3    32 #> 6     5      2 play_wild            16        12            4    32 unique(traced$trace[[1]]$total) #> [1] 32

title: Getting started with maumauR
text: interactive front end - understanding rule - play one action time. mm_step() advances game. Left alone asks seat’s strategy; given card position plays card, Shiny application clicks.
code: game <- mm_new_game(n_players = 3, seed = 42) game #> <mm_game>: 3 players, turn 0 #> • top card: "number" "red" (colour in force: "red") #> • hand sizes: 5, 5, and 5 #> • draw pile: 16; discard pile: 1 #> • to move: seat 1 mm_top_card(game) #> # A tibble: 1 × 4 #>   color value type   active_color #>   <chr> <int> <chr>  <chr>        #> 1 red       3 number red mm_hand(game, player = 1) #> # A tibble: 5 × 5 #>    card color  value type   legal #>   <int> <chr>  <int> <chr>  <lgl> #> 1    17 yellow     2 number FALSE #> 2    25 blue      NA plus2  FALSE #> 3    18 yellow     3 number TRUE  #> 4     7 green      2 number FALSE #> 5    14 blue       4 number FALSE mm_legal_moves(game) #> [1] 3 game <- mm_step(game, card = mm_legal_moves(game)[[1]]) game #> <mm_game>: 3 players, turn 1 #> • top card: "number" "yellow" (colour in force: "yellow") #> • hand sizes: 4, 5, and 5 #> • draw pile: 16; discard pile: 2 #> • to move: seat 2

what: How long do games run, and how much drawing is there?
title: Getting started with maumauR
text: Game length strongly right-skewed: games end quickly, drag +2 cards circulate.
code: by_size <- dplyr::bind_rows(   mm_simulate(n = 300, n_players = 2, seed = 21),   mm_simulate(n = 300, n_players = 3, seed = 22),   mm_simulate(n = 300, n_players = 4, seed = 23) )  mm_game_length(by_size) #> # A tibble: 3 × 7 #>   n_players games mean_turns sd_turns min_turns median_turns max_turns #>       <int> <int>      <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl> #> 1         2   300       19.3     9.83         7           18        77 #> 2         3   300       25.1    11.4         10           23        86 #> 3         4   300       29.5    12.6         14           26        82 mm_draw_summary(by_size) #> # A tibble: 3 × 7 #>   n_players games mean_draws sd_draws min_draws median_draws max_draws #>       <int> <int>      <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl> #> 1         2   300       8.50     6.33         0            8        47 #> 2         3   300      11.2      7.26         0           10        51 #> 3         4   300      13.1      7.98         2           11        47 mm_plot_game_length(by_size, bins = 25) mm_plot_draws(by_size, bins = 25)

title: Getting started with maumauR
text: strategy function (hand, state) returning position card play, NA draw pass. must return one state$legal.
code: lowest_first <- structure(   function(hand, state) {     if (length(state$legal) == 0) {       return(NA_integer_)     }     legal <- state$legal     values <- hand$value[legal]     values[is.na(values)] <- 99L     legal[[which.min(values)]]   },   class = c("mm_strategy", "function"),   strategy_name = "lowest_first",   color_picker = function(hand, state) state$active_color )  mm_win_rate(mm_simulate(   n = 200,   n_players = 3,   strategies = list(lowest_first, mm_strategy_greedy(), mm_strategy_greedy()),   seed = 5 )) #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   n_players  seat strategy      wins games win_rate #>       <int> <int> <chr>        <int> <int>    <dbl> #> 1         3     1 lowest_first    69   200    0.345 #> 2         3     2 greedy          76   200    0.38  #> 3         3     3 greedy          55   200    0.275

title: Simulation and analysis of the DB Mau Mau card game
text: Numbers 4000 games per table size identical greedy opponents, 1500 games per seat rotation head--head runs. Moving first helps, win rate falls monotonically table. three four players first seat clearly chance (95% confidence interval excludes ); two players edge within noise. Hoarding wild cards pays. Rotating one hold_wilds seat every position greedy opponents, finishes three five points chance (0.550, 0.378, 0.286 two, three, four players) - keeping card legal discard worth tempo lost playing . mm_strategy_random() goes way, winning 0.291 greedy seats around win 0.354, three players. Games short right-skewed. Mean turns mean cards drawn grow roughly five per extra player, tail long: four-player game averages 29 turns occasionally runs past 100. None 12000 simulated games failed finish. Reproduce mm_simulate() summary functions; see vignette code.
